releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260825.40+2f106c39"
  - revision: "2f106c39"
  - timestamp: "Tue Aug 25 17:25:30 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge branch 'SideStore:develop' into develop
- updated minimuxer to latest
- fixes for wireless pairing + validated on apple tv manually end-to-end
- rework wiring for both wireless pairing server and manually triggered client-pairing mode
- move to bg thread on getaddrinfo, removed invalid host probing
- make json response in sidejit manager to be pretty printed
- fix the bonjour discovery, formatting issues + sidejit mdns validation
- added logging + refine constants for bonjour
- added more logging for sidejit diagnostics
- jit: added alias domain for sidejit server in mDNS discovery
- fix most of bonjour issues and reduced unncessary scans + added more info in detail view
- added toolbar button to turn off auto-refresh
- fix: bonjour service entries weren't cleared for old/out of date ones.
- bonjour: bring back period refresh
- restored wireless pair coz it was too clunky - will redo properly in next few commits (+bonjour view make it manual for now)
- refine and consolidate the wireless pairing flow + manual pair trigger (+ some bonjour services enhancements)
- added more mdns addrs that we scan for including apple tv's remotepairing manual tcp
- attempt integrating wireless pair setup properly
- mDNS-sd: Fixes for infinite resolving issue in bonjour manager

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
